name: io.github.Alien6-Studio/outerspace-apizr
title: OuterSpace Apizr
description: Local stdio MCP: Python analysis, readiness, exposure plans and experiment history/comparison.

packageArguments.name: --project
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to your apizr.toml file selecting the Python source root. Create it using the Registry installation guide linked by websiteUrl; no project is selected automatically.

packageArguments.name: --operator-policy
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the operator-reviewed JSON policy granting source.analyze for that root. Create and review the analysis grant in the Registry installation guide; installation grants no permission.

packageArguments.name: --plugins-dir
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to your managed plugin directory. Prepare, install and explicitly activate the matching MCP profile there using the Registry installation guide before connecting; the launcher does not activate plugins.
